articles.title: Sophos Firewall v22 MR1 is Now Available
articles.summary: SFOS v22 MR1 introduces iSensor IPS technology from the Secureworks Taegis platform, providing NDR Active Threat Intelligence with curated IPS detection patterns. Detection extended to interactive/reverse shell compromises, blocking related TCP/UDP command and control activity across the full XGS Series lineup.

articles.title: Sophos Firewall: New XGS Series Desktop Firewalls and SFOS v21
articles.summary: New XGS series desktop firewall appliances for distributed edge with SFOS v21, improved performance and energy efficiency for SMB and branch deployments.

articles.title: Firewall performance for the campus edge with the XGS 7500 and XGS 8500
articles.summary: XGS 7500 and XGS 8500 campus edge firewalls: up to 190 Gbps firewall throughput, 92.5 Gbps threat protection, QSFP28 ports up to 100 Gbps, Xstream architecture with TLS inspection.

articles.title: Check Point Software Unveils Quantum Firewall Software R82.10 to Secure the AI-Driven Enterprise
articles.summary: Quantum Firewall Software R82.10 debuts 20 new AI security features to secure the AI-driven enterprise, with elevated zero trust and hybrid mesh security across cloud and on-prem firewalls.

articles.title: Check Point announces advancements to Quantum Force Security Gateways
articles.summary: Ten new Quantum Force firewalls deliver up to 3x higher threat prevention performance per rack unit; all data center and perimeter gateways receive a 15%-25% threat prevention throughput boost via software update. 50+ AI engines, up to 1 Tbps AI-fuelled threat prevention, 99.8% malware block rate.

articles.title: Check Point Launches New Branch Office Security Gateways with 4x Faster Threat Prevention Performance
articles.summary: AI-powered Quantum Force Branch Office Security Gateways with up to 4x threat prevention increase and 99.9% block rate. Quantum Spark 2500 series brings Wi-Fi 7 and 5G connectivity to the SMB market with fanless desktop units.

articles.title: Defend Against the Latest Cyber Threats with AI Security and Expanded Zero Trust for Hybrid Mesh Cloud and On-Prem Firewalls
articles.summary: New AI security capabilities and elevated zero trust across the hybrid mesh: cloud and on-prem firewalls managed under the Infinity Platform.

articles.title: Fortinet Expands FortiGate G Series to Secure AI from the Data Center to Modern Enterprise Edges
articles.summary: FortiGate 3500G delivers 595 Gbps firewall throughput and 179 million concurrent sessions for data centers; FortiGate 400G delivers 164 Gbps and 28 million sessions for the enterprise edge. Powered by NP7 and SP5 processors. FortiOS 8.0 adds inspection of MCP and agent-to-agent traffic plus native shadow AI detection across the Security Fabric.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Secures Agentic AI with Prisma AIRS 3.0
articles.summary: Prisma AIRS 3.0 secures the entire agentic AI lifecycle: agent discovery across cloud/SaaS/endpoints, AI red teaming simulating context-aware agentic attacks, and an AI Agent Gateway as central control plane for agent runtime and identity security.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Introduces Idira: the Next-Generation Identity Security Platform Built for the AI Enterprise
articles.summary: Idira is a next-generation identity security platform built for the AI enterprise, extending zero trust identity controls to human and AI agent identities.

articles.title: Prisma AIRS June 2026 update: unified VM-Series / AI Runtime Firewall image
articles.summary: A unified image consolidates VM-Series and AI Runtime Firewall (AIRS VM) into a single software version with license-driven operational mode and seamless runtime model updates without reboot. AI Red Teaming adds Privilege Misuse attack category aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Systems.

articles.title: Cisco Live: Security focus yields new firewalls, Hypershield integrations, and agentic AI defenses
articles.summary: Cisco expands Hypershield integrations and agentic AI defenses. N9300 Series Smart Switches use programmable DPUs to enforce stateful L3/L4 segmentation directly in the switch; Hypershield uses eBPF kernel-level visibility and autonomous rule lifecycle management within the hybrid mesh firewall ecosystem.

articles.title: Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks top Gartner's hybrid mesh firewall rankings
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, and Check Point hold the top three positions in Gartner's inaugural Hybrid Mesh Firewall Magic Quadrant. Gartner predicts over 60% of organizations will deploy multiple firewall types managed from a single cloud-based control plane, with SASE/SSE integration and AI-enabled threat prevention as standard requirements.
